title: Reasoning-Aware Multimodal Fusion for Hateful Video Detection

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating binary classification performance (Macro-F1, Accuracy, Precision, Recall) on multimodal video datasets (HateMM, MultiHateClip) that contain offensive and hateful content targeting specific demographic groups based on identity factors like religion, ethnicity, nationality, race, and gender.

Qualitative analysis and adversarial reasoning evaluations (e.g., objective vs. hate-assumed vs. non-hate-assumed prompting) to test the model's ability to correctly classify non-hateful videos that mention historically sensitive groups without triggering false positive judgments based on spurious correlations or implicit system biases.
